name: Daniil Medvedev
intro: Daniil Medvedev is a very tall player from Moscow. He is 6 feet 6 inches! His name means bear in Russian.
story: Daniil almost became a swimmer. At the pool he saw a sign for tennis lessons instead. He was a math whiz at school too. He won this tournament in 2021 and became world No. 1 in 2022. On Friday he beat Arthur Rinderknech, and he plays again Sunday.

funFacts.text: His biggest hobby is PlayStation. He even played in video game contests.
He loves chess and reading books.
He speaks three languages: Russian, English and French.
When he won here in 2021, he flopped down like a video game celebration.
He has two little daughters, Alisa and Vika.
He finished two years of math school in one year!
His favorite shot is the return of serve. Players call him the Octopus because he reaches every ball.

watchFor: Watch how far back he stands to return serve, almost at the wall.
